raw:
The user wants a confirmation dialog for a Taiwanese online banking app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). The user is transferring NT$12,500 to "王小明" and once sent, it cannot be canceled. They want:
- s1: dialog title
- s2: confirm button
- s3: cancel/abandon button
- s4: description text

Return only JSON: {"s1":"...","s2":"...","s3":"...","s4":"..."}

Taiwanese Traditional Chinese conventions for banking apps:
- 轉帳
- NT$12,500
- 王小明
- Cannot be canceled after sending: 送出後無法取消 or 轉出後無法取消/撤銷

Title: something like 「確認轉帳」or 「轉帳確認」

Confirm button: 「確認轉出」or 「確認轉帳」

Cancel button: 「取消」or 「放棄交易」— the field is 放棄按鈕, so maybe 「取消」 or 「返回修改」. In Taiwan apps, common: 「取消」. But since it's a dialog, "取消" is standard.

Description: Include recipient name, amount, and warning that it cannot be canceled after sending. E.g., 「您將轉帳 NT$12,500 給王小明。轉帳一旦送出即無法取消，請確認收款人資訊正確無誤。」

Use standard Taiwan phrasing. Also full-width punctuation.

JSON output only.

s1: "確認轉帳"
s2: "確認轉出"
s3: "取消"
s4: "您即將轉出 NT$12,500 至收款人「王小明」，款項送出後無法取消或退回，請再次確認收款人資訊是否正確。"

parsed.s4: 您即將轉出 NT$12,500 給收款人「王小明」。款項送出後即無法取消或退回，請再次確認收款人資訊正確無誤。
